en: A black-and-white postcard view of a European town seen from a distance across fields and a wooden fence. In the middle distance there are trees and low industrial buildings with a plume of smoke, while the background is filled with dense townhouses. Dominating the skyline is a large church with a tall tower and baroque-style dome roof. The overall appearance suggests an early-20th‑century photograph printed with a white border. At the bottom, in cursive script, is a caption naming the town.
